name: Immersive Shopping and Videos
author: aveytsman

sections.description:
Transform Your Online Store

Transform your online store with technology that help customers see, understand, and buy your products with confidence with or WITHOUT human interference. Perfect for products that need to be explained or demonstrated.

Show customers how your product will work for them RIGHT WHEN THEY NEED IT THE MOST. Guide them all the way to purchase with unparalleled shopping experience.

Results

Much higher conversions, reduced returns, increased AOVs, and solidified, trustworthy customer relationships.

Features

  • Autonomous Sales Agent is equivalent to store owner answering questions 24/7
  • Personal Shopping Assistant guides customers through purchases via video support
  • Live shopping with instant purchasing and sales tracking
  • Recorded shoppable videos with UGC sales tracking
  • Short product videos that sell better than pictures

See It In Action

Support

For technical support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit our support center or contact us directly through your admin dashboard.

Transform your online store today with immersive shopping experiences that convert browsers into buyers!
sections.installation:
• Log into your WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Go to “Plugins” using the sidebar on the left.
  • Click “Add New” and find “Immersive Shopping and Videos” in the search bar.
  • Install the plugin and activate it.
